scores.note: 2 'his life is alone', 4 'his life is by himself', 7 'his life is on his own', 10 'his life is in solitude' are ungrammatical in place (describe the man, not his life); 6 'his life is cut off' reads as life ended, wrong sense. 'isolated' and 'solitary' are strong; 'desolate' overstates slightly.
